features.statement: Page title appends a descriptive tagline after the brand or product name, separated by an en dash.
Hero H1 is very large (~54px), bold, in title case rather than all caps.
Body text is 16px with roomy line height; h2 headings are large (~34px) and bold.
Typography relies on a single system-ui font stack, with no web fonts or icon fonts.
Hero background is a diagonal gradient from dark blue to cyan instead of a flat color.
Palette uses dark blue-slate text with muted slate secondary text and a saturated royal-blue accent.
Alternating sections sit on a pale blue-gray background, with a near-black navy footer.
Primary call-to-action is a single fully rounded white pill button with no input field.
Suggested links appear as translucent pill chips after a small letter-spaced label.
Features are left-aligned bordered cards with rounded corners and colored square icon tiles.
Feature icons are emoji glyphs placed on colored tiles instead of icon-font glyphs.
Content cards have rounded corners, edge-to-edge images and tighter gutters, with uniform row alignment.
Card stats are unbordered columns with title-case labels and no dividers.
Missing images show a neutral gray 'No preview available' placeholder rather than a broken image.
Section headers use a large bold heading paired with a plain text link carrying an arrow.
Header logo is a blue gradient rounded-square mark, with links and language toggle grouped at right.
Footer is minimal: two columns of plain text, a horizontal rule above the copyright, and no social icons.
Footer navigation and labels use title case rather than uppercase.
Image alt text is descriptive, using a 'name screenshot' pattern.
Page is built with a few semantic sections, a single nav, and a clear h1–h2–h3 hierarchy.
Layout uses modern CSS grid and flexbox with a narrower centered container.
Page is self-contained, with no scripts or external stylesheets and one inline style block.
Styling uses few classes and no inline style attributes, with minimal transitions.
